bio: This little restaurant in the city centre promises a truly authentic Thai dining experience. Premium ingredients are precisely prepared for optimum flavour – the chef hails from Thailand and brings experience from esteemed establishments. In the evenings, guests can choose between a five- or eight-course set menu. On Wed, Thu and Sat, a shortened menu is served at lunchtime. The setting is upscale and tastefully designed, enhanced by attractive Thai decorative elements. The two very cordial proprietors provide attentive and adept service. Travel tip: The restaurant is not far from the main railway station and is well connected to public transport. Drivers can use the multi-storey car park in Stresemannstraße....
